The action domain is $[0,1]^d$. The Matern kernel $k_{
u,\ell}$ and its RKHS are public, with $
u,\ell>0$ and $k(x,x)=1$. The function sequence is fixed before interaction and satisfies $$\|f_t\|_{\mathcal H_k}\le B,\qquad \sum_{t=2}^{T}\mathbf 1\{f_t

operation.display_label_zh: Scalar reward of the selected action
operation.query_signature: Choose $x_t$ and observe $Y_t=f_t(x_t)+Z_t$ with $Z_t\overset{\mathrm{i.i.d.}}\sim\mathcal N(0,\sigma^2)$. There is one action-point observation per round. Causal policies are allowed and $T,S_{\mathrm{seg}},k,B,\sigma$ is public. Switching times and reward functions are hidden. Received feedback may be stored and reused computationally. No unrevealed historical information or extra queries to exhausted samples are available; any within-round full-function or common-sample access must be explicit.

steps: Choose $x_t$, then observe $Y_t=f_t(x_t)+Z_t$ with $Z_t\overset{\mathrm{i.i.d.}}\sim\mathcal N(0,\sigma^2)$. Only one action-point observation is available each round.
Causal strategies are allowed. The quantity $T,S_{\mathrm{seg}},k,B,\sigma$ is public; switching times and reward functions are hidden.

Received feedback may be stored and reused in computation. Unrevealed information cannot be requested from past rounds, and consumed random samples cannot receive additional queries. Current-round exceptions are limited to the explicitly supplied full-function access or same-sample two-point interface.
